quarterly_data.quarter: Santec investor Q&A summary: Q1 FY2027 shareholder and small-meeting Q&A (09-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management: with the whole optical communications market booming on data-center investment for generative AI, supply and demand for parts is tight market-wide and some parts have become hard to procure; the company is responding by reviewing suppliers and using substitutes.

quarterly_data.quarter: Santec investor Q&A summary: Q1 FY2027 shareholder and small-meeting Q&A (09-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management: optical components capacity is being expanded mainly at its contract factory in Vietnam; in Q1 capacity did not ramp to the originally planned level because hiring and training the needed staff took time. The new Canada factory, originally planned to start in July, is now expected to start operating around September-October because of construction delays. The Q1 gross margin fell mainly on optical components product mix and higher depreciation from production investment.

quarterly_data.quarter: Santec investor Q&A summary: Q1 FY2027 shareholder and small-meeting Q&A (09-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management: data-center investment for generative AI remains at a high level and demand for both optical components and optical instruments is expected to stay firm; it sees no slowdown in customer demand or major trend change and orders are strong, though it is hard to foresee how long demand will last, so it is strengthening production while watching customers.
